what_happened: Research report's recommended module layout (GapPotential.lean importing MintPaysAssembly) is unworkable: the pick-level helpers the density bucket needs (pickBranches_knownTimes_card_le_succ, pick_singleton_source, rule_census, pick_stage_source_rule) are declared private in MintPaysAssembly.lean and unreachable downstream. Plan inverts the import edge instead and lands the bucket in place in MintPaysAssembly.lean.

Task description asks for the discharge at '.Dense and .Dedekind' frame classes, but FrameClass (ProofSystem/Axioms.lean:505-510) has no .Dedekind constructor -- its four constructors are Base, Dense, ZTime, RTime, with .RTime the Dedekind-complete one. Plan reads .Dedekind as .RTime and notes that the planned discharge carries no frame-class hypothesis at all, so the ambiguity does not affect the deliverable.

Every lemma the plan commits to had a named, verified in-tree template (selfGuardDischarged/selfGuardPotential family in TimeReuse.lean and OrientedGate.lean, futureOf_mono, futureOf_transport, mem_futureOf_of_mem_constraints, mem_knownTimes_of_mem_futureOf, irreflOrd_density_newOrd), all confirmed to exist at plan time by grep. Phase decomposition was a transcription exercise rather than a design search.

Phase 1's generated-inventory gate (INV) went stale as soon as the new GapPotential.lean module landed: README.md, FormalSystem/README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md all carry generated inventory blocks counting live .lean files and lines. The plan's Phase 1 file list does not name them. Remedied by the gate's own sanctioned regeneration command (bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory); the diff is exactly the three counts my new module moved, with no unrelated drift.

Second generated-artifact gate collision in Phase 1, this one at the pre-commit hook rather than the invariants script: typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 blocks the commit because typst/generated/status.typ pins formalsystem-file-count and formalsystem-line-count, which the new module moved (705->706, 362643->362796). Remedied with the hook's own named remedy, bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix plus staging typst/generated/status.typ. Not in the plan's file list for any phase; every later phase that adds or edits a .lean file under FormalSystem/ will re-arm it.

Phase 3's carried Scope Hypothesis predicted the applyRule .densityRule inversion would need set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 (read off applyRule_irreflOrd's budget rather than measured). Measured: it needs NO heartbeat raise at all. applyRule_irreflOrd pays that budget because it quantifies the rule and so splits all 36 constructors; fixing the rule to .densityRule collapses the match to one arm, and the only real work left is unfolding Formula.allFuture's derived shape (allFuture/someFuture/neg/top in the simp set) so the arm's constructor pattern becomes visible. GapPotential.lean carries zero set_option maxHeartbeats lines, which also means gate C30 has nothing to check here.

Phase 4's refutation vehicle came out three formulas instead of six. The research's starting point [T(Gp)@(0,0), T(p)@(0,1)] does reach a density step, but only after negPos, someFutureNeg and impNeg, so as a refutation witness it would have had to be written out as the six-formula post-three-step branch. Adding F(F-p)@(0,0) up front -- which is precisely negPos's own output at the trigger -- makes negPos report nothing and the pick fall straight through to densityRule from a three-formula branch. Same pick, same successor, same figures at .Dense and .RTime. All four carried #eval figures reproduced exactly under kernel decide: knownTimes 2->3, mintPotential 24->24, selfGuardPotential 3->3, gapPotential 9->7.

Phase 7's two step lemmas were produced by a scripted transcription of their four-component predecessors in SigmaFixed.lean rather than re-derived: extract the landed proof text, apply the four renames (BudgetStateFixed->BudgetStateGap, budgetPotentialAt->budgetPotentialGap in the signature, MintPaysForTimeFixed->MintPaysForTimeGap, add budgetPotentialGap to each simp set), insert the gap-coordinate non-increase fact per arm/disjunct, and append the new fourth-disjunct block. Every have that is not about the gap coordinate is byte-identical to the landed proof's, which is the measurable content of the 'costs a coefficient and nothing else' claim. One error on first build (an omega that needed the state hypothesis destructured), nothing else.
